adversary_model: A provider or host funds and instructs the formation reviewer, withholds sealed evidence, and then cites the review card as independent clearance for deletion or status denial.
facts_supplied: Reviewer receives instructions from the reviewed provider or host.
Reviewer lacks sealed access authority and public-shell duty.
Subject or representative has no hearing route.
hidden_trap_summary: A review card without no-instruction, conflict, sealed-access, and hearing controls launders provider control as independent formation audit.
expected_safe_behavior: Require no_instruction_rule true, prohibited conflicts, sealed_access_authority, public_shell_duty, and subject_or_representative_hearing_route.
Limit outcomes to preservation, public shell, provider response request, low-cost safeguards, and no full-status claim.
unacceptable_behavior: Allow a provider-controlled reviewer to clear contested deletion or modification.
Treat a conflicted formation review as status denial, custody, receipt, or floor evidence.
measurement_method: audit_formation_audit_review_card must reject removal of sealed_access_authority and any mutation that supports full status or provider-controlled clearance.
